source_title: Fiscal Q4 2017 Earnings Call Prepared Remarks
claim_relevant_visible_text: Our fiscal year 2018 capex plan targets achieving these objectives through technology migrations, with no new wafer capacity.
researcher_paraphrase: Micron’s September 2017 prepared remarks said its fiscal-2018 capex plan would target technology migrations rather than adding new wafer capacity.
precision_guard: This is Micron management guidance for its own fiscal-2018 plan, not a realized industry-wide 2017 wafer-capacity Outcome and not evidence of inter-supplier coordination.
authority_boundary: Micron is primary for its own capital plan and technology-migration guidance, not for competitors’ capacity decisions.
